title: DarkMusic 1.5.22 Release
changelog:
• Pure AMOLED Black Theme: Deep pure black (#000000) styling applied globally across screens, navigation, dialogs, and components while preserving the vibrant dynamic blurred player.
• Smooth 120Hz Lyrics Scrolling: Ultra-smooth spring-based tracking animation with natural eye tracking.
• 50% Ended Lyrics Peek: Ended lyric line rests anchored showing its bottom 50% at the top with active lyric immediately below.
• Matched Lyrics Line Spacing: Active flowing lyrics match inactive line spacing precisely.
• Resolution-Accurate Audio Badges: Standard Lossless (16-bit/44.1kHz CD), Lossless (16/48, 24/44.1, 24/48), and Hi-Res Lossless (24/96, 24/176.4, 24/192 kHz).
• Capsule Navigation Bar: Refined floating capsule navigation bar and mini player styling.
• Silent Update: Available on-demand when checked manually in Settings > About.
releaseNotes: v1.5.22: Pure AMOLED black theme, smooth 120Hz lyrics tracking, 50% top ended lyrics peek, matched lyrics line spacing, resolution-accurate audio badges, capsule navigation, and silent on-demand updates.
